packageRules.description: Merge an update once every CI check on its branch has passed. The Automerge workflow merges it as soon as CI passes; Renovate also merges it during its own runs. rebaseWhen above makes Renovate rebase a branch that is behind main (the runner's own config only rebases conflicted ones), so an update opened while main was red gets a new CI run once main is fixed.
The ANTLR tool generates the parser and the ANTLR runtime runs it, so both move to a new version together.
The PIT JUnit 5 plugin runs inside PIT, so both move to a new version together.
Maven build plugins only affect the build: update them in one pull request.
Update the CI workflow's actions in one pull request.
